description: Per-resource metadata for owner review. Estimates are rounded to the owner's scale (10 / 15 / 20 / 30 / 45 min) and assume a first pass with the needed information to hand. They exclude any time spent gathering information such as quotes or measurements. Estimates for OG-B04, OG-B10 and OG-25 approved by the owner on 2026-09-22.

OG-B04.foundationTypeStatus: as deployed and approved 2026-09-22 (recorded explicitly so prep no longer relies on a MEDIUM-confidence audit value)

evidence.nature: short reflective planning answers: month, theme, why it matters, check-in day, what to share, partner, how to measure, baseline, target

OG-B04.reasoning: About a minute to read, then nine short answers of a line or two and a checklist to skim. Reused monthly, so the estimate is per month.
OG-B04.difficultySource: OWNER-APPROVED CLASSIFICATION — not source-derived. The source document does not state a difficulty level (searched for beginner, intermediate, advanced, difficulty, level, skill, experience: zero matches).

evidence.nature: budget burn-down with arithmetic (starting budget, remaining at days 30/60/90, a 10-20% contingency), phase breakdown, action dependencies and supplier lead times

OG-B10.reasoning: Short to read but the most thinking per field: budget figures need working out and dependency mapping means reasoning about the order of actions. Labelled Advanced, and assumes a plan already exists.
OG-B10.difficultySource: SOURCE-SUPPORTED — the document's own title reads '90-Day Implementation Roadmap (Advanced)'

evidence.nature: a brief for a tradesperson: project overview, resilience context, scope of works, commercial terms, attachments checklist, evaluation criteria

OG-25.reasoning: The longest document and the most demanding writing: a scope of works and commercial terms are substantive. 45 minutes assumes the member already knows what they want done; gathering measurements or quotes would add to it.
OG-25.difficultySource: OWNER-APPROVED CLASSIFICATION — not source-derived. The document states no difficulty. Its only use of the word 'level' is a form field, 'Target Resilience Level (Days of autonomy desired)', which is about the household, not the document.
